thread:
Sam: FYI Paladin wants a 3-week POC for their customer-tuned 'paladin-narrative-8b'. They asked for an experimental INT2/ternary quant variant, embeddings + reranker, BYOK KMS, and p95 < 200ms for short responses (~80 tokens). Can SE/Infra confirm viability and any blockers?
Yara: INT2 is cutting-edge; our conversion tool can try INT2 but itmay increase inference variance. Need model weights and the exact training recipe to ensure compat with our kernel codepaths. Request: model.tar.gz, config.json, tokenizer.json, and a small eval set (50 prompts + expected outputs).
Diego: Reranker plan  we should separate generation vs reranking pipelines. Reranker likely prefers FP16 to avoid rank flips; embeddings can be INT8/quantized with a separate embeddings pool. If they insist on INT2 for gen, we should propose a hybrid: INT2 gen + FP16 reranker.
Priya: Security: BYOK + KMS OK, need signed DPA; also they require log-redaction for any customer text sent to debug. For Hosted Dedicated we can proxy their KMS key; for Private we can mount their key directly. Ask region (US/EU) for data residency.
Nate: Perf: to hit p95<200ms at bursts of 25 qps I recommend Dedicated baseline 2x A100-80GB with aggressive warm_pool and small max_batch_wait (<=5ms). INT2 might reduce compute but we need conversion perf numbers. Also advise separate pool for embeddings with larger batch sizes.
Yara: SE checklist: 1) validate tokenizer + token counts 2) run conversion to INT2 and run sanity generation tests 3) perf sweep for p50/p95/p99 4) reranker accuracy/regression test vs FP16 baseline.
Sam: Commercial: quote-bot can you sketch two options: Hosted Dedicated POC (30d) and Private onboarding? Need rough deltas for INT2 conversion engineering time.
quote-bot: Draft: Hosted POC (30d) = $20k trial (incl. limited BYOK proxy). Private onboarding = $20k setup + $10k/mo infra. Engineering conversion fee estimate +$8k (one-time) for experimental INT2 conversion/validation. Final quote pending token volumes.
Diego: Perf command I'll run once artifacts arrive:
```
python perf.py --model paladin-narrative-8b-int2 --ctx 80 --batch 1 --steps 200
```
Expect initial perf + regression numbers within 72h of artifacts.
Yara: Also request: their reranker eval set (queries + relevance labels) so we can measure rank stability after quant. If rank degradation > 5% we recommend FP16 reranker.
Sam: Action items: I'll request artifacts and schedule a tech sync Tue. Priya, please start security questionnaire. Nate, can you prepare an autoscale sketch we can share?
infra-bot: ticket INF-5033 created (Paladin POC). Assigned Yara (ml-eng), Nate (infra), Priya (security). Due 2026-04-20.
Priya: Will take the questionnaire. Also ask customer about retention period for logs (30/90/365).
Sam: Great. I'll update Paladin and loop AE.
